blurb: Guests pay per ride with no entrance fee. The park features classic rides from the 1950s, including the oldest continuously operating steel roller coaster in its original location in North America. Miniature golf is also available with special pricing for young children.
extraNote: Tickets never expire; save unused tickets for future visits · Closing times and operating hours are subject to change based on weather and crowd conditions
